goals: Preserve sixteen selected Regions Unexplored plants as focused Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric content without a runtime dependency on Regions Unexplored.
Retain reference gameplay, assets and practical shader movement where target APIs permit, with narrow compatibility repairs and explicit 26.2 additions.
scope: Glowleaf (upstream Dropleaf) plus its body block, Barley, Windswept Grass, Clover, historical Stone Bud, Mycotoxic Daisy, Hyssop, five Lupines, Cattail, Duckweed, Tassel and Meadow Sage as sixteen obtainable items; the display-only Glowleaf name preserves the upstream dropleaf registry and resource identity.
Reference-supported potted Hyssop, five Lupines and Mycotoxic Daisy; exact focused private resource assembly; support, growth, loot, food, recipe, compost, fire and bee behaviors.
Optional client-only Iris aliases inherit the active shader pack's vanilla short-foliage, tall-half, lily-pad and weeping-vine classifications while preserving explicit mappings and excluding pots.

exclusions: No RU world generation, biomes, trades, other plants, Grass Sprouts substitution, Create recipe without a supported 26.2 serializer, or first-copy acquisition path.
No Regions Unexplored, Iris, shader-pack or Create runtime requirement; no shader/profile edits, hardcoded shader material IDs or potted-plant wind aliases.
No runtime deployment, Test Instance Manager slot changes, Ribbits or Mynx Trees edits, protected-profile access, or redistribution of reference binaries/private artwork.

dependencies.reason: Exact target for audited block, item, data and client APIs.
Fabric loader baseline for the target game.
Content registration, creative-tab, compost, fire and client color APIs.

The exact 16-item/24-block registry surface, Glowleaf behavior and lighting, other plant behavior, private resources and shader mappings remain unchanged. Clean build passes one Java and eleven Python checks. Exact private artifact retained. ACTIVE / NOT_DEPLOYED / RUNTIME_UNTESTED.
